Basic audio transcription

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.CreateTranscriptionRequest{
		Model: `whisper-1`,
		File:  `audio.mp3`,
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Transcribe(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Text)
}
```
